strategies.name: session_bias_opening_range_retest_scalp

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: if I want to buy, I want to see a bullish engulfing pattern form before my trading session
entry_sequence.action: For long setups, use the 7:00 a.m. and 8:00 a.m. 1-hour candles to require a bullish engulfing pattern before the New York session; for short setups, require a bearish engulfing pattern before the session.
entry_sequence.rationale: The pre-session 1-hour engulfing pattern sets the session bias.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: I'm marking out the top and the bottom of that range from 9:30 to 9:45
entry_sequence.action: On the 5-minute chart, mark the opening range using the high and low from 9:30 to 9:45 a.m. Eastern.
entry_sequence.rationale: The first 15 minutes define the trading range for the session.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: I'm simply looking for the price to break and close outside of that range
entry_sequence.action: For longs, wait for price to break and close above the opening range; for shorts, wait for price to break and close below the opening range.
entry_sequence.rationale: The break and close outside the range confirms momentum in the bias direction.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: step three is all about finding a point of interest
entry_sequence.action: After the range break, identify a point of interest such as demand/support for longs or supply/resistance / range retest for shorts and wait for price to retrace into it.
entry_sequence.rationale: The retrace into the point of interest provides the entry location.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: it taps into the level of demand, and it clearly respects the level
entry_sequence.action: Enter when price taps the chosen point of interest and shows respect there; for the long example, the speaker also used a bullish engulfing pattern at the level, and for shorts he also uses the classic break-and-retest entry at the range boundary.
entry_sequence.rationale: The speaker waits for the retracement to react from the chosen area before taking the trade.

stop.transcript_quote: I like it below the range
stop.rationale: The speaker places the long stop below the opening range and, on shorts, above a recent wick to stay beyond invalidation.

strategies.stop_management: Set break even once price moves sufficiently in favor; the speaker says, "I set break even" during the short example.

targets.transcript_quote: I'm always going to look left and see what I can find
targets.rationale: The speaker selects profit targets by looking left for a reaction level.

targets.transcript_quote: we had an aggressive level of supply
targets.rationale: For longs, he targeted into a supply zone because price can react there.

targets.transcript_quote: that was the last level that had a huge push down
targets.rationale: He also uses the last strong push-down level as the take-profit reference.

confluences.description: The setup is traded during the 9:30 to 11:00 a.m. Eastern window.

confluences.description: The first 15 minutes of the NYSE open define the session's trading range.

confluences.transcript_quote: This break of the range tells me the buyers have some momentum
confluences.name: range_break_momentum_confirmation
confluences.description: A break of the opening range is used as momentum confirmation in the bias direction.

confluences.transcript_quote: we have a level of demand off of this candle right here

confluences.transcript_quote: You get the break of recent structure
confluences.name: break_of_recent_structure
